goal: Prevent peers from bypassing node orphan memory limits and mounting memory exhaustion attacks
Ensure memory accounting matches real usage for transactions with many tiny witness elements
agreement: Strong support with verified testing and no open objections
Verified eviction of memory-heavy orphans and test failure on master (jeanpablojp)
Tested ACK after reviewing logic and testing (nervana21)
Resolved prior concerns over candidate lookup memory spikes and tx breakage (instagibbs, jeanpablojp)
Minor open suggestions regarding fuzz test usage assertions (nervana21)

categories.name: p2p
why: P1 because it fixes a remote memory exhaustion vulnerability in orphan transaction handling
Peers can currently exceed memory caps by 28 times using standard-weight transactions with tiny witness data
A peer can force hundreds of megabytes of heap allocation and delay validation processing
